extDescription.message: Select an amount, right-click and convert it at your Moldovan bank's rates: maib, MICB, Victoriabank, OTP, BNM and more.

ambiguousNote.message: Ambiguous separator, so both readings are shown.

srcGuessed.message: The amount's currency wasn't recognised. Pick it above.

feeNote.message: * includes the 0.1% fee on buying foreign cash

staleNote.message: Couldn't reach $1, so these are the last saved rates.

errNoNumber.message: No number found in the selection

errBusy.message: $1 is limiting requests, try again in a few minutes

errTimeout.message: the $1 page did not load in time

noteFincombank.message: Cash: branch no. 3, bd. Dacia 20. Other branches may differ.

noteVictoriabank.message: Cash: branch no. 3 rate. Other branches may differ.

noteEnergbank.message: Central Office rates. Other branches may differ.

optIntro.message: Select an amount on any page, right-click and choose “Convert…”.

optDisclaimer.message: Rates are read from the banks' websites and are for information only; the bank's rate at the time of the transaction applies. This extension is not affiliated with any bank.

optPrivacy.message: The extension collects no data: the selected text is processed only in your browser.
